# Pinthia

> Pinthia is a free Pinterest board downloader. Paste a link to a public Pinterest board, section or profile and get one zip with every pin, with the board's sections kept as folders.

Pinthia works on public boards only. It needs no account and no sign-in, and it is free. It is made by one person.

## What it does

- Downloads a whole Pinterest board, a single section, or every board on a profile, plus pin.it short links.
- Keeps the board's sections as folders inside the zip.
- Saves original-size images, videos, GIFs, carousel slides and idea-pin pages.
- Lets you pick which sections or pins to include before downloading.

## How to use it

1. Copy the link of a public Pinterest board.
2. Paste it at https://pinthia.github.io/
3. Choose what to keep, then press Download.

## Forms

- Website: https://pinthia.github.io/ (works on desktop and phone, installable as an app)
- Browser extension for Safari, Chrome and Firefox: download from the website ("Add extension"). It builds the zip on your own computer.

## Limits

- Public boards only. Secret boards cannot be downloaded.
- Pinthia is not affiliated with Pinterest.
